Short title, extent and commencement

NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY ACT, 1991 (ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER,
2000
NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY ACT, 1991 (ADAPTATION AND
ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 17th May, 2000]
S.R.0.466(1)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--An Order to adapt and enforce the National Highway Authority Act,
1991 in the Northern Areas;
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the National Highway Authority
Act, 1991 (Adaptation and Enforcement) Order, 2000.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Northern Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: National Highway Authority Act 1991 Adaptation and Enforcement Order 2000
sections.description:
Adaptation and enforcement of National Highway Authority Act, 1991

NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY ACT, 1991 (ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER,
2000
NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY ACT, 1991 (ADAPTATION AND
ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 17th May, 2000]
S.R.0.466(1)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--An Order to adapt and enforce the National Highway Authority Act,
1991 in the Northern Areas;
2. Adaptation and enforcement
of National Highway Authority Act, 1991.--The National Highway Authority
Act, 1991 (XI of 1991), as in force in Pakistan immediately before the
commencement of this Order, all Rules, Notifications and Orders made or issued
thereunder, are adapted and shall, as far as practicable, apply and be in force
in the Northern Areas, subject to the modification that in the aforesaid
Ordinance, the expression "Provincial Government" shall be construed
to refer to the Government of Pakistan.
